app.title: Meeting room booking
app.description: Booking meeting rooms in the office

auth.loginSubtitle: Your work email and password. The schedule opens right after.
auth.registerSubtitle: Colleagues see your name next to your bookings on the grid.
auth.loginDescription: Sign in to book a meeting room: a week of the room on one grid, half-hour slots, your own bookings yours to edit.
auth.registerDescription: Create an account to book meeting rooms in the office: pick a free slot on the weekly grid and edit or cancel it whenever you need to.
auth.name: Name
auth.pitchTitle: A room's week at a glance, free time included
auth.pitchGrid: Seven days across, half-hour slots down, weeks either way.
auth.pitchOwn: Edit and cancel your own bookings; everyone else's are read-only.
auth.pitchZone: Times are shown in your own zone, wherever you work from.
auth.pitchOffice: Working hours are 09:00–19:00 in office time ({zone}).
auth.loginFailed: Could not sign in. Please try again
auth.registerFailed: Could not create the account. Please try again
auth.verifyBanner: Confirm {email} to start booking. You can already browse the schedule — the link is printed to the server log.
auth.resendDone: A new link for {email} is in the server log.
auth.resendFailed: Sending failed — try again in a minute.

rooms.title: Meeting rooms
rooms.roomLine: {name} · floor {floor} · {capacity, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}
rooms.roomMeta: Floor {floor} · {capacity, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}
rooms.emptyText: Nobody has added a meeting room yet. Ask in #office — it is quick.
rooms.emptyFilteredTitle: No rooms with {capacity} seats or more
rooms.emptyFilteredText: Try a smaller filter — something more compact may do.
rooms.subtitle: A week of the room at a glance — and the free time with it.

schedule.hint: Click for 30 min, drag for longer. Your own booking can be dragged, or resized by its edge.
schedule.hintTouch: Swipe between days. Tap a free slot for 30 min; the end is set in the panel.
schedule.emptyWeekText: Any slot between 09:00 and 19:00 is yours — click one.
schedule.verifyFirst: Confirm your email first — the link is in the banner above the grid.
schedule.pastDay: This day is already over — you can only book future time.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.moveBooking: Move your booking (while it has the focus)
shortcuts.resizeBooking: Change how long your booking runs
shortcuts.close: Close the panel or the dialog

form.clash: This time is already taken by another booking. Pick another time, day or room.
form.seriesNote: You are editing a single occurrence — other weeks stay as they are.
form.failed: Could not save the booking. Please try again
form.switchRoomText: The schedule behind will switch to {name}. The title and repeat settings you have already entered will be lost.

myBookings.title: My bookings
myBookings.emptyUpcomingText: Open the schedule — free slots are visible at once and booking takes two clicks.
myBookings.emptyPastText: Once your bookings finish, they move to this tab.
myBookings.loadFailed: Could not load the next page. The rows already shown are still there.
myBookings.endOfList: That is all your bookings — {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}

cancel.question: Cancel “{title}”?
cancel.explanation: The slot frees up for everyone else. For a few seconds afterwards you can still take it back — as long as nobody has claimed the slot.
cancel.seriesExplanation: This is one occurrence of a weekly series. Choose what to cancel — the slot frees up for everyone else.
cancel.failed: Could not cancel it — the booking is still there. Please try again.
cancel.done: Booking cancelled · the slot is free
cancel.seriesDone: Series cancelled · the slots are free

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: We write to you when something affects your bookings.
notifications.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the list. The next attempt is in half a minute.
notifications.endingSoon: “{title}” is ending soon — the room is taken next
notifications.item: “{title}” is ending — {room} is taken right after.

errors.notFoundText: The link may be out of date. Sign in and we will show you the schedule.
errors.notFoundTextAuthed: The link may be out of date. Go back to the schedule — everything is where you left it.
errors.appNotFoundText: It may have been removed from the list. Your bookings in other rooms are untouched.
errors.loadFailed: The connection seems to have dropped. Nothing is lost — try again.
errors.pageFailedTitle: The page could not be loaded
errors.pageFailed: The connection seems to have dropped. Try again — your data is intact.

api.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong email or password. Check your layout and Caps Lock
api.FORBIDDEN: You can only change your own bookings

api.OUTSIDE_WORKING_HOURS: Bookings run {from}–{to} Kyiv time — pick a slot inside that window

api.TITLE_REQUIRED: Add a title — colleagues see it on the grid
api.TITLE_TOO_LONG: The title cannot be longer than {max} characters
api.END_BEFORE_START: The end has to be later than the start
api.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address to book. The link is in the server log
api.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again
api.NAME_TOO_LONG: The name cannot be longer than {maxName} characters
api.EMAIL_INVALID: Enter your email — the confirmation goes there
api.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password is shorter than {minPassword} characters — add a few more
api.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The password cannot be longer than {maxPassword} characters
